title: Mario Kart World [Switch 2]
description:
Mario Kart World is a Nintendo Switch 2-exclusive kart-racing game and a major evolution of the Mario Kart formula. Instead of treating every circuit as an isolated location, its courses and roads are connected inside one large world that spans grassy plains, cities, deserts, oceans, mountains, snowfields, volcanic areas and more.

Grand Prix expands races to 24 drivers. Each cup links four courses together, and the roads between those courses can become part of the race itself. Knockout Tour is a continuous cross-world rally: 24 racers start together and the lowest four are eliminated at each checkpoint until the final group reaches the finish.

Free Roam lets the player leave formal racing behind and drive across the connected map. Players can search for P Switch missions, coins, ? Panels, Peach Medallions, secrets and scenic photo opportunities. The world features changing weather and day/night conditions.

Mario Kart World introduces Charge Jump, Rail Ride and Wall Ride, while familiar drifting, tricks, boosts and items remain central. Rewind can be used in appropriate solo situations to retry a maneuver or correct a mistake.

Up to four people can play on one Nintendo Switch 2 system, Local Wireless supports up to eight players, and online races can support up to 24. CameraPlay and GameChat add optional camera/video features with compatible hardware and Nintendo Switch Online.

The game also includes VS Race, Time Trials and multiple Battle formats. Post-launch free updates expanded the game with team-based Knockout Tour, Bob-omb Blast, new Knockout Tour routes and additional Photo Mode features.

description_short: A Nintendo Switch 2-exclusive open-world Mario Kart that connects courses through a large free-roaming world, supports 24-driver races, Knockout Tour, Free Roam, local multiplayer, online play, CameraPlay, and ongoing free updates.
description_ar:
Mario Kart World هي لعبة سباقات كارت حصرية لجهاز Nintendo Switch 2، وتمثل واحدة من أكبر التغييرات في تاريخ سلسلة Mario Kart. بدلاً من أن تكون الحلبات منفصلة تماماً، أصبحت الطرق والحلبات والمناطق جزءاً من عالم واحد مترابط يمكنك القيادة داخله والتنقل بين مناطقه المختلفة.

في Grand Prix تتنافس ضد ما يصل إلى 23 متسابقاً آخر، أي 24 متسابقاً في السباق. يتكون كل كأس من أربع حلبات مترابطة، ويمكن أن تكون الطرق التي تصل بينها جزءاً فعلياً من السباق.

يقدم Knockout Tour سباقاً طويلاً مستمراً عبر مناطق متعددة. يبدأ 24 متسابقاً، وعند كل نقطة تفتيش يتم استبعاد أصحاب المراكز الأخيرة حتى تصل المجموعة النهائية إلى خط النهاية. أضافت Nintendo لاحقاً سباقات فرق لهذا النمط عبر تحديث مجاني.

أما Free Roam فيسمح بالقيادة بحرية في العالم. يمكنك العثور على مهام P Switch، وجمع العملات و? Panels وPeach Medallions، واكتشاف الأسرار والتقاط الصور وتجربة الطرق والقفزات المختلفة. العالم يتغير بين أوقات اليوم المختلفة وحالات الطقس.

تضيف اللعبة تقنيات مثل Charge Jump وRail Ride وWall Ride، إضافة إلى Rewind في مواقف اللعب الفردي المناسبة.

تدعم اللعبة حتى 4 لاعبين على جهاز واحد، وحتى 8 عبر Local Wireless، وحتى 24 عبر الإنترنت. كما تدعم CameraPlay وGameChat عند استخدام الأجهزة والخدمات المتوافقة.

إلى جانب Grand Prix وKnockout Tour وFree Roam توجد Time Trials وVS Race وBattle، وتشمل Battle أنماط Balloon Battle وCoin Runners وBob-omb Blast بعد التحديثات المجانية.

وصل أحدث إصدار رسمي عند إعداد هذا الملف إلى Ver. 1.7.0، الذي أضاف مسارين جديدين لـKnockout Tour وإمكانية وضع الملصقات في Photo Mode.

worldSummary:
Mario Kart World takes place across a single interconnected driving world rather than completely disconnected race venues. Roads connect plains, cities, deserts, waterways, mountains, icy regions, jungles and volcanic landscapes.

Formal courses remain important, but the roads between them are also designed for racing. Grand Prix events can travel across connecting roads and into the next course.

Free Roam exposes the connected structure directly. Players can explore side roads, drive over terrain, search for P Switch challenges, coins, ? Panels, Peach Medallions and secrets, or use Photo Mode. Weather and time of day can change as the player travels.

There is no traditional narrative campaign. The world is primarily a mechanical and exploratory framework connecting racing modes, challenges, collectibles and multiplayer.

faq.q: Is Mario Kart World available on the original Nintendo Switch?
faq.a: No. Mario Kart World is exclusive to Nintendo Switch 2.
Supported races and Knockout Tour can include up to 24 drivers; local player limits depend on the multiplayer configuration.
Free Roam lets players leave formal races and explore the connected world, complete activities, find collectibles and take photos.

verdictSummary:
Mario Kart World is the series' largest structural change in years. Instead of treating every course as an isolated location, it connects tracks through a broad world that supports Free Roam, point-to-point racing and the elimination-based Knockout Tour.

The 24-driver field creates busy, unpredictable races, while Free Roam adds a relaxed exploration layer for players who want more than repeated Grand Prix events. The trade-off is that the open-world structure changes the pacing and some players may prefer the tighter, more focused course design of earlier Mario Kart games.

Nintendo has continued expanding and balancing the game through free software updates, including new Knockout Tour routes and Photo Mode sticker functionality in Ver. 1.7.0.
verdictPros: Large connected world that makes Mario Kart feel meaningfully different from earlier entries.
Up to 24 drivers create chaotic and varied races, especially in Knockout Tour.
Strong variety between racing, Free Roam, Battle, multiplayer and post-launch free updates.
verdictCons: Open-world travel can feel less focused than traditional compact Mario Kart course selection.
Three- and four-player split-screen uses a lower frame-rate presentation in independent technical testing.
Some players may prefer the denser dedicated-track design of Mario Kart 8 Deluxe.

reviews.quote: The perfect introduction to a new console generation.
Racing with the crew remains first-class fun.

patchNotes.body: Added Drill Rally and Boomerang Rally to Knockout Tour; added stickers to Photo Mode including touch/mouse placement; adjusted acceleration, gliding, hit recovery, water Jump Boost behavior, landing-on-rivals dash time, slipstream braking and item-box acquisition rates; plus fixes.

Added Bob-omb Blast to Battle plus additional adjustments and fixes.

studioAbout:
Mario Kart World was developed by Nintendo's internal development organization, commonly credited as Nintendo Entertainment Planning & Development (Nintendo EPD), and published by Nintendo.

Nintendo's official Ask the Developer Vol. 18 identifies key staff including producer Kosuke Yabuki, programming director Kenta Sato, art director Masaaki Ishikawa and music lead Atsuko Asahi.

Development began during the original Nintendo Switch generation. Nintendo explained that one interconnected world and a larger number of racers created performance/design challenges on the original hardware. The project later moved to Nintendo Switch 2, allowing the team to pursue the connected-world concept and 24-driver races.

Nintendo also discussed more than 200 new musical arrangements created for the game's world/jukebox music system.
